id_rule: Canonical overlay source IDs are SHA-1(url without trailing slash), first 12 uppercase hex, prefixed SRC-.

sources.title: 'Unknown projectile' hits oil tanker off Oman: UKMTO
sources.proof_note: Preserves UKMTO's reported occurrence time, location, engine-room damage, vessel disablement and safe crew. Attacker attribution remains unresolved.

sources.title: Pakistan and Iran made 'significant progress' in talks on conflict, minister says
sources.proof_note: Supports the Pakistani military/minister readout of progress and the stated focus on escalation control, Hormuz reopening and negotiated settlement; does not prove a final deal.

sources.title: Iran and Oman discuss temporary Hormuz corridor as impasse with US drags on
sources.proof_note: Supports the joint temporary corridor/mine-clearing framework and separately reports the Iranian state-TV Barron Trump segment plus Secret Service awareness. The broadcast is not treated as proof of an operational state assassination plan.

sources.title: Trump says Strait of Hormuz has been demined, warns Iran not to plant more
sources.proof_note: Establishes Trump's mine-clearance claim and zero-tolerance warning; Reuters does not independently establish that every mine was cleared.

sources.title: US starts returning staff to Middle East missions after Iran war evacuations, sources say
sources.proof_note: Supports phased staffing returns and the inference that Washington assesses lower near-term escalation risk; does not imply zero risk.

sources.title: Iran's gas lines are growing, but there's no sign so far that its leaders will bow to US sanctions
sources.proof_note: Supports direct observation of fuel queues and subsidy debate while explicitly noting no broad protest wave at publication.

sources.title: US oil prices extend losses on hopes of Iran-Oman talks on Strait of Hormuz
sources.proof_note: Supports WTI's further decline after the Aug. 25 Oman-Iran framework; market price movement is a risk signal, not proof of actor intent.
